title: /reports/[id]
responsibility: Redirects a former report address to the console, which opens the explorer where that report belongs.

inputs.name: load.params
inputs.description: The route params object passed to load; only params.id is read, as the legacy report identifier. It is percent-encoded with encodeURIComponent and appended to /harness/reports/ without any format check, so an id containing an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate makes the call throw a URIError instead of redirecting.

outputs.name: load
outputs.description: Never returns: the call always ends by throwing, either the 308 redirect or a URIError, so no value reaches a caller.

errors.name: Redirect
errors.description: The 308 permanent redirect thrown by redirect(308, ...) from @sveltejs/kit, with the location /harness/reports/ followed by encodeURIComponent(params.id). It is the outcome for every id that encodes without error.

errors.name: URIError
errors.description: Thrown by encodeURIComponent(params.id) when the id contains an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate, so the call ends with this error and no redirect is thrown.
